europe_now.title: Trilateral Peace Negotiations on Ukraine in Abu Dhabi
europe_now.summary: Delegations from Ukraine, Russia, and the United States have resumed diplomatic talks in Abu Dhabi. Meanwhile, American officials noted some flexibility shown by the warring sides during the ongoing negotiations.

sources.headline: Live: Ukraine, Russia and US to resume peace talks in Abu Dhabi
Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say

europe_now.title: French Investigation Into Cyberattack Blamed on Iran
europe_now.summary: Paris prosecutors have opened a formal inquiry targeting an Iranian cyber unit following a series of cyberattacks that impacted supermarket refrigerator systems in France. French authorities formally attributed the hostile digital operations to Iran.

sources.headline: France blames Iran for cyberattack on supermarket fridges
Paris prosecutor opens probe into IRGC cyber unit Shahid Kaveh over fridge cyberattacks

top_stories.title: Military Exercises in Poland
top_stories.summary: Military exercises have commenced in Poland under the Coalition of the Willing framework. These drills are designed to build and prepare logistical and operational support for postwar Ukraine.

sources.headline: Coalition of the Willing military exercises begin in Poland to prepare support for postwar Ukraine

top_stories.title: Corporate Leadership Scrutiny Over Intelligence Reports
top_stories.summary: Nvidia shares experienced a decline following revelations that the company board is investigating its chief executive officer. The internal probe follows allegations concerning a relationship with a purported foreign intelligence operative.
